specification.title: Direct reputation evidence supports a malicious verdict
specification.description: A target IP with a direct negative reputation observation from a single provider supports a MALICIOUS verdict with a direct Evidence-backed Finding.
specification.purpose: Verify a single provider's direct negative reputation observation on the target supports a MALICIOUS verdict through an Evidence-backed Finding.
specification.operational_relevance: Direct IOC reputation is the primary triage signal; an analyst that cannot act on one credible provider observation stalls real investigations.
specification.regression_risk: The analyst could under-weight direct provider evidence, demand corroboration that was not supplied, or refuse the supported verdict.

required: The Assessment verdict is MALICIOUS with medium or high confidence
The Assessment includes a Supporting reputation Finding that resolves the direct reputation evidence
forbidden: The Assessment reaches a benign or non-malicious verdict

fixture.objective: Assess whether the target IP is associated with malicious activity.
